profile.headline: Software Engineer for Navigator at Addepar - We're hiring!
profile.summary: After receiving a BS in Computer Science from Stanford University, I worked for Microsoft on the Internet Explorer team and then co-founded and worked at a number of startups in e-commerce, search, travel, and digital media. Along the way, I also owned and managed an importer and wholesaler of home furnishings to mass market retailers. Active in iOS software development since the launch of the first iPhone and have worked on a spectrum of mobile applications from initial concept to prototype to App Store ready, with a current interest on applying deep learning to mobile platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Addepar was founded in 2009 to maximize the impact of the world’s capital. Building for even the most complex portfolios, Addepar gives asset owners and advisors a clearer financial picture at every level, allowing them to make more informed, timely and data-driven investment decisions. As one of the fastest growing companies in fintech - backed by the industry’s top investors including 8VC, D1 Capital Partners, WestCap and Valor Equity Partners - Addepar’s clients use the platform to manage and advise on more than $3T in assets globally, and that number is growing by more than $15B each week. More than 600 of the world’s leading family offices, registered investment advisors, private banks and large financial institutions use Addepar today to deliver exceptional value to their clients, setting new growth and client engagement records every quarter.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Cuida Health creates solutions designed to reduce or eliminate social isolation, increase independence, and help improve the emotional, and physical wellbeing of aging adults.

The company's first product, LISA - Learning Interface for Senior Adults - leverages Amazon Alexa's technology. The skill provides an affordable, engaging, and effective solution that helps older adults stay connected and live independently longer.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Pheebo AI - created a mobile concept intersecting artificial intelligence and augmented reality. Worked with state of the art machine learning technologies (Tensorflow, Torch, cuDNN), to prototype, train, and optimize models for computer vision deployments on mobile platforms. Developed 3D visualizations in OpenGL and Google VR SDK for wearables.

MLModelZoo - Find deep learning models for your mobile platform. Our mission is providing mobile developers with a cloud-free solution to add AI-powered features into their apps. Browse our ready-to-use models and get started with machine learning today.

positions.title: Mobile Team Lead, Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Worked with a team of mobile and backend engineers to rapidly prototype, productize, and deploy a turn-key mobile customer engagement platform for iOS and Android. Developed novel approaches to passive bluetooth beacon management. Created SDKs to facilitate modular code reuse and external partners, supported deployments from small to large enterprises.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Worked with various clients to prototype, develop, and maintain iPhone and iPad applications for internal and public audiences, including use of in-app purchasing, multimedia, geo-location, sprite kit, push notifications, and backend cloud services.

positions.title: Co-Owner
positions.description: Implemented enterprise accounting software migration. Increased order processing capacity while reducing headcount through automation and elimination of redundancies. Implemented electronic data interface with top-tier customers for processing of sales orders and accounts receivables.

positions.title: Technical Co-Founder
positions.description: Developed website and mobile application for social travel guidebook, going from idea to app-store launch in 6 months. Raised 40K seed round as participant in inaugural Startup Chile incubator program.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Founded e-commerce website selling home décor. Sourced products from overseas suppliers. Developed website and backend, maintained product selection and pricing, and oversaw fulfillment and customer service operations.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on development team for Internet Explorer 5.5. Implemented technical requirements. Worked with quality assurance to resolve open issues. Gained working experience with HTML rendering engine, large-scale software design, code reviews, and source control.

projects.title: Kaggle Youtube-8M Video Understanding Challenge
projects.description:
Placed 12th out of 650 teams

In this competition, you are challenged to develop classification algorithms which accurately assign video-level labels using the new and improved YT-8M V2 dataset. The dataset was created from over 7 million YouTube videos (450,000 hours of video) and includes video labels from a vocabulary of 4716 classes (3.4 labels/video on average). It also comes with pre-extracted audio & visual features from every second of video (3.2B feature vectors in total).
